title: Bout V3.0
description: What the instances of a flow of one Data Type on one Port have in common, given once as a Zstandard dictionary (RFC 8878, section 5) whose Dictionary_ID is the BoutID. Each instance of the flow travels as a Zstandard frame compressed with it.

BoutID.description: Identifier of the Bout and Dictionary_ID of its dictionary and of every frame compressed with it; never reused by the Controller, or the User Agent, that gives it.

DataType.description: Header of the Data Type of the instances of the flow.

PortNumber.description: Port Number of the Port of that Data Type that the flow is on.

Method.description: The compression method: Zstandard, IETF RFC 8878.

Dictionary.description: The Zstandard dictionary (RFC 8878, section 5), in Hexadecimal ASCII: its Dictionary_ID is the BoutID; its content is the canonical form of an instance of the Data Type.

SigningMode.description: EachInstance: every instance is signed. Chain: every instance carries its AuditChainHash; every ChainInterval-th instance is signed.

ChainInterval.description: In Chain mode, the number N: the instances whose Sequence is a multiple of N are signed.

RepeatInterval.description: Milliseconds between repetitions of the Bout; absent or 0: not repeated, given on request.

MaxInstanceLength.description: The largest size, in bytes, of the canonical form of an instance: a frame whose content size exceeds it is refused before it is decompressed.

DataXMData.description: The Data Exchange Metadata of the Bout: its Source, its Binding <Data Type>#<Port Number>@<stamp of its writer>/<BoutID>, its Signature and KeyID, made by the Controller that writes it.
